prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, late 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, top bun platinum silver hair — her bare skin covered from the neck down in moire and op-art interference patterns: fine black and white concentric lines and ripple grids overlapping across her torso, arms and legs, producing shimmering curved wave bands that appear to pulse and bend around her body, the pattern sitting on living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the pattern fading out at the neck. Her face, ears, neck and hands are real living skin with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a soft natural flush. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of polished charcoal leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy charcoal polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.

Background: the grand marble staircase of an opera house with standard-height steps, a waist-high carved balustrade, chandeliers and warm daylight from tall windows, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
